Starling is the better default choice if you want a simple, free, full-featured current account

client_claims.text: Both are fully regulated UK banks with FSCS protection.
Monzo also has no card-spend fees but applies overseas ATM limits/charges in some cases.
client_claims.note: No card-spend fees matches F6; the ATM limits and charges match F7.

client_claims.text: Monzo offers loans, Flex credit, savings and paid plans alongside its current account.
client_claims.note: F8 confirms paid plans exist; loans and Flex are not covered by the facts.
